name: elastic_structured_full
mechanism_or_hypothesis: Elastic-net shrinkage can share weak additive evidence across safe calendar, categorical, historical-support, and novelty signals.
falsification: Reject if it fails to beat the reconstructed champion robust PR-AUC or loses more than 5% Recall@Top-5%.

name: elastic_no_categories
mechanism_or_hypothesis: Explicit ablation of opening-time sparse categorical identity from the elastic model.
falsification: Falsify categorical value if removal does not reduce robust PR-AUC or operational recall.

name: elastic_no_history_novelty
mechanism_or_hypothesis: Explicit ablation of point-in-time outcome backoff and novelty/support features.
falsification: Falsify historical/novelty value if removal does not reduce robust PR-AUC or operational recall.

name: elastic_no_volume_context
mechanism_or_hypothesis: Explicit ablation of prior-day and rolling-volume context while preserving deterministic calendar features.
falsification: Falsify volume-context value if removal does not reduce robust PR-AUC or operational recall.

name: linear_svm_structured
mechanism_or_hypothesis: A maximum-margin sparse ranker may outperform likelihood optimization under extreme imbalance.
falsification: Reject if monthly paired wins or operational recall do not improve.

name: extra_trees_structured
mechanism_or_hypothesis: Randomized bagged trees may capture discontinuous interactions without boosting's sequential focus on rare positives.
falsification: Reject if gains are unstable or Recall@Top-5% degrades by more than 5%.

name: hist_gradient_boosting_structured
mechanism_or_hypothesis: Regularized histogram boosting may generalize differently from the deep locked XGBoost champion.
falsification: Reject if it cannot improve paired robust PR-AUC with stable workload.

name: xgboost_safe_reconstruction
mechanism_or_hypothesis: Reconstruct the locked XGBoost without the temporally uncertain assignment group to isolate model-family versus feature effects.
falsification: Use as a safe boosting reference; reject as a promotion if it fails the complete gate.

name: word_tfidf_logistic
mechanism_or_hypothesis: Reconstruct the retained lexical mechanism without champion blending to isolate its contribution.
falsification: Reject standalone text if it loses operational recall or paired temporal stability.

name: word_char_tfidf_svm
mechanism_or_hypothesis: Character shapes should generalize templated alert variants and identifiers that word tokenization fragments.
falsification: Reject if character augmentation fails to improve robust PR-AUC over word-only text with non-degraded recall.

name: nbsvm_word_char
mechanism_or_hypothesis: Class-conditional log-count ratios can amplify rare violation-associated lexical patterns before a regularized linear fit.
falsification: Reject if the NB transform fails to improve over the plain word/character margin model or destabilizes Top-5% recall.

name: hybrid_nbsvm_xgboost
mechanism_or_hypothesis: Fixed equal-rank fusion of safe structured boosting and NB-SVM text.
falsification: Reject if the fusion cannot pass the predeclared complete gate.

name: active_seasonal_median3
mechanism_or_hypothesis: Reconstruct the locked production comparator exactly.
falsification: Fail if any horizon differs from outputs/previsoes_baseline.json by more than 0.011 MAE.

name: seasonal_ewma13
mechanism_or_hypothesis: Exponentially weighting same-weekday history may reduce median noise.
falsification: Reject unless aggregate Q4 MAE improves over the active baseline.

name: ridge_ar_full_real
mechanism_or_hypothesis: A regularized direct multi-horizon AR can combine calendar and state safely.
falsification: Reject unless paired aggregate MAE improves without WAPE regression over 5%.

name: extra_trees_full_real
mechanism_or_hypothesis: Bagged randomized trees may capture nonlinear lag interactions.
falsification: Reject unless mean seeded MAE improves and seed variation is operationally small.

name: hist_gradient_full_real
mechanism_or_hypothesis: Shrinkage boosting may model regime and calendar interactions.
falsification: Reject unless mean seeded MAE improves and no seed fails secondary WAPE.

name: ridge_safe_synthetic_equal
mechanism_or_hypothesis: Fold-safe block bootstrap may stabilize linear coefficients.
falsification: Reject unless it beats the paired real-only Ridge and the active baseline.

name: ridge_safe_synthetic_reduced
mechanism_or_hypothesis: Downweighting synthetic rows may retain seasonal support without dominance.
falsification: Reject unless it beats real-only Ridge and equal-weight augmentation.

name: sgd_safe_synthetic_pretrain_finetune
mechanism_or_hypothesis: Synthetic pretraining followed by real-only fine-tuning may transfer seasonality.
falsification: Reject unless every seed beats the active baseline MAE.

name: ridge_safe_synthetic_lag_init
mechanism_or_hypothesis: Synthetic history may be useful only to initialize long lags and rollings.
falsification: Reject unless it improves on real-only Ridge without synthetic targets.

name: ridge_provided_synthetic_diagnostic
mechanism_or_hypothesis: The supplied generator may appear helpful because it copied test-period distribution.
falsification: Always ineligible; use only to quantify generator-artifact risk.

name: ridge_ablate_calendar
mechanism_or_hypothesis: Calendar/Fourier features provide incremental information beyond state lags.
falsification: Calendar is retained only if full Ridge beats this drop-family ablation.

name: ridge_ablate_rolling
mechanism_or_hypothesis: Rolling distribution summaries provide incremental regime information.
falsification: Rolling summaries are retained only if full Ridge beats this ablation.

name: ridge_ablate_trend_residual
mechanism_or_hypothesis: Recent trend/residual correction adds signal beyond levels.
falsification: Trend/residual is retained only if full Ridge beats this ablation.

name: ridge_ablate_weekly_lags
mechanism_or_hypothesis: Weekly aligned lags are the core short-series mechanism.
falsification: Weekly/state lags are retained only if full Ridge beats this ablation.

name: calendar_adjusted_seasonal
mechanism_or_hypothesis: Known weekday holidays and the Dec 24-31 reduced-activity window share an estimable demand factor.
falsification: Promotion requires >=10% MAE gain, >=5/7 horizon wins, and <=5% WAPE regression.

name: robust_residual_rule
mechanism_or_hypothesis: Carry last same-weekday pressure forward and adjust for recent robust level shift/persistence.
falsification: Fails paired 15% PR-AUC gate or temporal/workload guardrails.

name: logistic_calendar
mechanism_or_hypothesis: Estimate stable calendar-only high-workload propensity.
falsification: Calendar-only ranking does not beat seasonal baseline.

name: logistic_calendar_lags
mechanism_or_hypothesis: Add autoregressive level signals to the transparent calendar model.
falsification: Lag-family ablation has non-positive paired gain over calendar-only.

name: logistic_full
mechanism_or_hypothesis: Linear combination of calendar, lag, rolling, residual, and regime evidence.
falsification: Full features do not improve over calendar+lags or are temporally unstable.

name: isolation_regime_hybrid
mechanism_or_hypothesis: Use Isolation Forest to amplify only high-side context anomalies on top of the robust rule.
falsification: Unsupervised novelty adds no paired outcome association or destabilizes folds.

name: extra_trees_no_rolling
mechanism_or_hypothesis: Capture nonlinear interactions without rolling-distribution features.
falsification: Does not beat linear/full and baseline gates.
ablation: Tree model with rolling-distribution family removed.

name: extra_trees_full
mechanism_or_hypothesis: Capture nonlinear interactions across all point-in-time feature families.
falsification: Rolling family is non-incremental or candidate fails temporal gates.

name: hist_gradient_boosting
mechanism_or_hypothesis: Sequentially fit nonlinear residual structure with bounded shallow leaves.
falsification: No paired improvement or excessive fold/seed sensitivity.
ablation: Boosting inductive bias on the same full feature matrix as cycle 7.

name: hybrid_rank_blend
mechanism_or_hypothesis: Equal within-fold rank average of Extra Trees, full logistic, and fixed robust rule; weights are fixed, not fit on evaluation data.
falsification: Fails any paired, monthly, half-year, or workload gate.
ablation: Ensemble versus strongest constituent on identical folds.
